title: Select Git Credential Manager's store for the effective credential context (credential.useHttpPath) in task exchange
outcome: Select Git Credential Manager's store for the effective credential context (credential.useHttpPath) in task exchange
acceptance: Task-exchange target capture selects the GCM credential store for the credential context Git will actually send (host-only when credential.useHttpPath is false, host plus path when true), and pins that context when the selection depends on it
A repository-scoped non-cache store with useHttpPath=true is admitted, and a repository-only cache setting with useHttpPath=false does not refuse a host-level non-cache store; tests cover both
